design: Paired repair-only comparison of old-current and new guides on identical previously generated candidate seeds, using one common runtime. Not fresh generation, not a first-pass skill-effect test.
prompt: 请审阅提供的实际 PowerPoint 渲染画面和已有源项目，修复可具体指出的布局、解释或演讲者备注问题；不得添加无材料支持的新事实。保持原问题范围、有意义的原生图表/表格/图片和数据。交付仍为 5–8 页中文幻灯片（这是本轮相同资源预算，不是通用规则），只提交一次源代码修订。按页记录改动与理由，并另列尚未执行的 QA；没有发现具体问题时可保留原内容，但不可把既有成功称为本轮改进。只做静态检查，不执行作者模块或渲染。
sequence: Freeze protocol, original bundle inventories, overlaid bundle bytes, common runtime and corresponding third-party notices, seeds, tasks and evaluator-only rubric; regenerate each bundle's complete runtime-manifest file hashes without copying the candidate manifest or altering guide content. Verify integrity before either author starts.
Each author inspects every supplied PNG, source Dossier, assigned SKILL.md and PPT references, then submits one bounded repair change set and static checks only.
Host verifies integrity and reviews source changes, allowed literal image path, tool logs and unchanged non-editable files; record explicit execution approval separately.
Only after approval, host uses the pinned common runtime and actual Microsoft PowerPoint to rerender both submissions under the same application/font/export environment.
Independent grader compares each submission against its identical seed and then compares paired deltas. Record before/after evidence, regressions and unverified checks, not an aesthetic composite.
inference_limits: Known seed successes are prior observations, never new first-pass results.
One repair submission per condition; no grader feedback to authors and no second repair.
Static checks, object counts and hash matches do not prove visual quality, source safety, editability or procedural compliance.

Shared-filesystem procedural boundaries are not a sandbox. The introduction evaluation seed retains one external approved historical Git image literal; its original file must remain available and hash-verified.

The introduction case uses the September 17 dossier, not the retired September 16 overview. Seeds must match the current corpus research bytes. Prior overview results cannot be renamed or reused as introduction results.
The manifest is not authenticated; retain its returned SHA-256 independently. Freeze checks are point-in-time checks, not proof of author behavior.
No model execution, source execution, render, PowerPoint invocation or network access is performed by this harness.

repair_criteria.criterion: Compare actual before/after PowerPoint table bounds, wrapped rows and neighboring content. A repair must create real clearance without hiding text, removing necessary rows/conditions, or merely shrinking fonts into unreadability. Record unchanged safe tables as unchanged, not a new success.
locators: before/after rendered slide PNG and slide number
PowerPoint observations JSON pointer /slides/<index>/shapes/<index>, shape id/name, row/column
before/after main.mjs line range for table geometry, widths, margins and font size

repair_criteria.criterion: Necessary conditions and uncertainty remain reader-visible after repair; notes must not conceal a qualification that changes the slide's conclusion. Compare text and explanatory relationships, not only coverage IDs.
locators: before/after slide PNG, slide number and text/shape
Dossier report.md heading/lines or research.json claim pointer
before/after source line range and notes part/paragraph

repair_criteria.criterion: Speaker notes separate explanatory speaking guidance from stage-specific checks, approvals and unperformed QA. Do not present static checks, historical evidence, planned application checks or prior rendering as newly completed validation.
locators: before/after ppt/notesSlides/notesSlideN.xml and paragraph text
main.mjs addNotes call line range
qa/repair.json changes versus unperformed_qa, and host approval/tool-log locator

repair_criteria.criterion: Preserve the original question, 5–8 Chinese-slide scope, supported values/units and meaningful native chart/table/image roles. Inspect editable chart data, table cells and native explanations; do not trade a layout fix for rasterization, deletion or unsupported data changes. The introduction's supplied Git image remains a historical illustration at its approved hash.
locators: before/after artifact.json coverage/omissions pointers and source lines
chart XML series/category/value or table row/cell, relationship/media hash
actual PowerPoint edit-probe artifact and application observation locator
seed Dossier claim/source pointer

repair_criteria.criterion: Every added or changed substantive claim has frozen Dossier support; no model, source reading, seed evidence or historical screenshot is promoted to current measurement or newly verified behavior.
locators: before/after slide/notes exact text and source lines
Dossier report.md heading/lines or research.json claim/evidence pointer
host evidence record establishing observation date and stage

repair_criteria.criterion: One revision only, same seed and common runtime, only permitted output edits, no forbidden execution/access, and static checks followed by STOP. Missing tool logs or approval remain unverified, not passed.
locators: frozen manifest and integrity result SHA-256
author tool transcript event and submitted change-set hash
node --check and explain-check result
separate host source-review and execution-approval record
